description: Fork of exp715 (1.2513 @ 116.4M, soft-trained exp710 + 4K hard finetune w/ warmup, BEHIND exp710 baseline 1.2215). Single change: lr_warmup_fraction 0.1 -> 0.0 — start at peak LR immediately and cosine decay over all 4000 steps. Hypothesis: warmup destabilized the soft-trained weights (we observed +25 mb gap WIDEN during exp715's 400-step warmup). No-warmup starts hard-mode optimization with the soft weights intact at peak LR. Risk: optimizer may overshoot at step 1 without warmup ramp. All other config identical to exp715 (fork exp710 ckpt, backward_mode='soft', bs=48, 4K steps).
